Players Committee card image of [[The Client]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “During your control phase, if present at a site and your bounty hunter occupies a battleground, opponent loses 1 Force. Once per game, if you just lost a bounty hunter anywhere, may ▲ a bounty hunter.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/c241f88/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual14-Dark/hires/theclient.png Images-HT/starwars/Virtual14-Dark/hires/theclient.png] as of commit c241f88 “vset14” (18 March 2021).
